//: Markup-fidelity fixture for the GRID COLUMN item (svelte layout/Column.svelte, keen Grid.column/1). SCOPE = the flex column item inside a pc-row (modelled by grid.json). Core's column is `<div class="pc-col-{size}">` (foundation class from @keenmate/pure-css, see snippets/grid.html). NOTE the `pc-` prefix (foundation-owned), not `pa-`. `size` is a percentage (5% increments 5..100), a fraction alias (1-2, 1-3, …, 11-12), or `auto`; with NO size (and no responsive size) the column is the bare `pc-col` (flex:1 auto-equal). Responsive sizes prefix a breakpoint (pc-col-{sm|md|lg|xl}-{size}); base offsets are `pc-offset-{5..95}`; three flex modifiers are pc-col--no-padding / --grow / --shrink. The body is plain slot text so the diff checks only the column's tag + class + nesting. See grid.json for the row container + label.json for the modifier model.

propsVocabulary.size: base width — percentage (5..100 step 5), fraction alias (1-2 … 11-12), or `auto`. Omit → bare `pc-col` (flex:1). → pc-col-{size}
propsVocabulary.noPadding: boolean — zero the column's gutter padding (pc-col--no-padding)
propsVocabulary.body: the column's content area — plain slot text here
propsVocabulary.extraClass: extra classes appended verbatim (class passthrough — not a core feature)

goldenConventions: Structural only. A sized column is `<div class="pc-col-{size}">`; a column with no size (and no responsive size) is the bare `<div class="pc-col">`. Responsive + offset + modifier classes are added per set feature. The body slot is a plain text token (Content) so the diff checks tag + class + nesting. Class-token order + whitespace are normalized away, so goldens are written for readability.

features.//: Feature→class contract authored from dist/css/main.css. `size` (+ the responsive sm/md/lg/xl) expand over the full width vocabulary — auto, the twenty 5%-increment percentages (5..100), and the fifteen fraction aliases — each verified to exist in main.css by the axis-1 forward check. `offset` expands over the nineteen pc-offset-{5..95}. The only `.pc-col--*` BLOCK MODIFIERS in main.css are no-padding, grow, shrink (all claimed). The sizing classes are SIBLING classes (pc-col-50, pc-col-1-2 — single dash), not `pc-col--*` modifiers nor `pc-col__*` elements, so the axis-1 reverse checks (scoped to `pc-col--*`/`pc-col__*`) don't read them. Base `.pc-col` exists as a real rule. `produces: null` only for the slot + class passthrough.

extraClass.note: class passthrough — appended verbatim, not a core feature

cssStateClasses.//: All pc-col--* modifiers (no-padding, grow, shrink) are feature-driven; none are JS-toggled state classes.
